english: A metropolis composed of innumerable clusters of residential buildings. Its streets and buildings are strictly maintained, and it contains all the public facilities and amenities needed for its residents to live in peace and comfort. The lights in the giant ceiling above the complex simulate day and night, and shelters are built into the ground to protect citizens from danger. Those peaceful days came to an end when the strange monsters attacked...
german: A metropolis composed of innumerable clusters of residential buildings. Its streets and buildings are strictly maintained, and it contains all the public facilities and amenities needed for its residents to live in peace and comfort. The lights in the giant ceiling above the complex simulate day and night, and shelters are built into the ground to protect citizens from danger. Those peaceful days came to an end when the strange monsters attacked...

english: Takumi's classmate and childhood friend. She has a gentle demeanor, but is also surprisingly resilient. She lost her father at a young age, and her mother spends most of her time doing research. In spite of all this, Karua works hard to be the best person she can be. Takumi was separated from her when the strange creatures attacked the complex.
german: Takumi's classmate and childhood friend. She has a gentle demeanor, but is also surprisingly resilient. She lost her father at a young age, and her mother spends most of her time doing research. In spite of all this, Karua works hard to be the best person she can be. Takumi was separated from her when the strange creatures attacked the complex.

english: A peculiar school located outside of the Tokyo Residential Complex. It is humanity's last line of defense against certain destruction. The Special Defense Unit has been tasked with protecting the academy from all harm for the next 100 days.
german: Eine eigenartige Schule außerhalb des Wohnkomplexes von Tokio. Sie ist die letzte Verteidigungslinie der Menschheit gegen eine gewisse Zerstörung. Die Special Defense Unit wurde beauftragt, die Akademie für die Akademie in den nächsten 100 Tage vor allen Schaden zu schützen.

english: A barrier created by generators placed around the school. If it takes too many hits and its integrity falls to zero, it will disappear. The invaders will then be free to storm the academy and destroy humanity's last hope for survival.
german: Eine Barriere, die durch Generatoren rund um die Schule errichtet wurde. Wenn sie zu viele Schläge braucht und ihre Integrität auf Null fällt, verschwindet sie. Die Angreifer können die Akademie stürmen und die letzte Hoffnung der Menschheit zerstören.

english: A team of remarkable young people charged with protecting Last Defense Academy, and by extension, the future of humanity. No matter what hardships the unit might suffer, they cannot be allowed to fail in their mission. To do so would spell certain doom for all mankind.
german: Ein Team bemerkenswerter junger Menschen, die mit dem Schutz der Last Defense Academy und damit beauftragt sind, die Zukunft der Menschheit zu schützen. Egal, unter welchen Schwierigkeiten die Einheit auch immer leiden mag, sie in ihrer Mission darf, sie nicht scheitern. Das wäre ein sicherer Untergang. Das würde für die Menschheit wäre ein sicherer Untergang.

english: Strange creatures fixated on getting inside Last Defense Academy. Their ultimate aim is to acquire "{fc(ff635b)a certain special something}" hidden within the school. If the Special Defense Unit cannot stop them, all of humanity will perish.
german: Seltsame Kreaturen, die darauf fixiert sind, in die letzte Verteidigungsakademie einzudringen. Ihr oberstes Ziel ist es, "{fc(ff635b)ein gewisses spezielles Etwas}" zu erwerben, die in der Schule versteckt sind.

english: Powerful warriors that rule over the regular School Invaders. They are immune to conventional weaponry and can only be damaged with hemoanima. In addition to their formidable fighting prowess, each commander also possesses unique abilities.
german: Mächtige Krieger, die die über die regulären Schulinvasoren herrschen. Sie sind immun gegen konventionelle Waffen und können nur durch Hämoanima beschädigt werden. Neben ihrer beeindruckenden Kampfkraft verfügt jeder Kommandant über einzigartige Fähigkeiten verfügt jeder Kommandant über einzigartige Fähigkeiten.

english: A mysterious form of energy that gifts its wielder with powers so great they border on supernatural. It's the only known force capable of harming the invaders. When activated, it solidifies into Class Armor and Class Weapons. The form these take is unique to each member of the Special Defense Unit. This is also what allows Takumi and the others to use their {fc(ff635b)Specialist Skills}.
german: A mysterious form of energy that gifts its wielder with powers so great they border on supernatural. It's the only known force capable of harming the invaders. When activated, it solidifies into Class Armor and Class Weapons. The form these take is unique to each member of the Special Defense Unit. This is also what allows Takumi and the others to use their {fc(ff635b)Fachkenntnisse}.

english: Full name: Hematomorphic Infusion Blade. Widely regarded to be the pinnacle of human achievement and ingenuity, at least according to Sirei. When stabbed with one of these blades, a member of the Special Defense Unit has their blood replaced with hemoanima, allowing them to use special powers.
german: Vollständiger Name: Hämatomorphe Infusionsklinge. Weithin als der Gipfel menschlicher Leistung und Einfallsreichtum betrachtet, zumindest laut Sirei. Wird mit einer dieser Klinge gestochen, wird, wird einem Mitglied der Speziellen Verteidigungseinheit das Blut durch Hämoanima das Blut durch Hämoanima ersetzt, was es Hämoanima ersetzt, was es, was ihnen erlaubt, so dass sie besondere Kräfte eingesetzt.

english: Otherworldly flames that never go out. A unique feature of Last Defense Academy, they surround the school up to a radius of 1 kilometer. They will incinerate any living matter they touch, making them an ideal defense against the invaders.
german: Eine einzigartige Eigenschaft der Last Defense Academy ist, dass sie die Schule bis zu einem Radius von einem Kilometer umgeben. Sie verbrennen jede lebendige Materie, die sie berühren, woben werden, woben, woben, wodurch sie sie sie sie sie sie eine ideale Verteidigung gegen die sie sich gegen die Invasoren sind. Sie so dass sie eine ideale Verteidigung gegen die Invasoren sind.

english: Part of the automated Defense System, these machines convey fallen students to the Infirmary for treatment and revival. They spring into action the moment they detect a member of the Special Defense Unit's life signs cease, but are only effective within the Wall of Fire. Venture off school grounds, and you're on your own!
german: Part of the automated Defense System, these machines convey fallen students to the Infirmary for treatment and revival. They spring into action the moment they detect a member of the Special Defense Unit's life signs cease, but are only effective within the Wall of Fire. Venture off school grounds, and you're on your own!

english: A machine in the school Infirmary that is indispensable to the war effort. By harnessing the power of hemoanima, it can return the dead to life. However, it will only work if the person in question hasn't been dead for long.
german: Eine Maschine im Schulkrankenhaus, die für den Kriegseinsatz unverzichtbar ist. Indem sie sich die Macht der Hämoanima zunutze macht, kann, kann sie Tote wieder zum Leben erwecken. Das funktioniert aber nur, wenn die betreffende Person noch nicht lange tot ist. Das funktioniert nur, wenn sie nicht lange tot ist.

english: These machines can be used to temporarily put out a section of Undying Flames. This allows students to slip through the Wall of Fire and explore the outside world. Like most technology at Last Defense Academy, hemoanima is what allows the fire extinguishers to work their magic.
german: Wie die meisten Technologien an der Last Defense Academy ist Hämoanima das, was es den Feuerlöschern ermöglicht, ihre Magie zu verrichten.

english: The heart of Last Defense Academy, defended by an imposing door covered in Undying Flames. The invaders must be kept out of this room at all costs. If they get their hands on what's inside, mankind's extinction is guaranteed.
german: Das Herz der Last Defense Academy, verteidigt durch eine imposante Tür, die in Flammen verschleiert ist. Die Eindringlinge müssen um jeden Preis aus diesem Raum ferngehalten werden. Wenn sie an das Innere in die Hand bekommen, ist, ist, ist, ist, ist die Auslöscht die Menschheit garantiert, ist die Auslöschung garantiert.

english: It may look like something you'd find in a video game arcade, but this is actually a state-of-the-art training device. Students can use it to experience virtual reality mock battles, sharpening their skills and strengthening their hemoanima.
german: Es mag wie etwas aussehen, das man in einer Videospielarcade findet, aber es ist tatsächlich ein hochmodernes Trainingsgerät. Studenten können damit virtuelle Realität simulierte Schlachten erleben, ihre Fähigkeiten schärfen und ihre Fertigkeiten und ihre Fähigkeiten und ihre Hämochieren und ihre Hämotieren und ihre Hämoanima stärken.

english: A machine capable of creating a wide variety of items. Just select the item you want and insert the required materials - it's as simple as that! The items made by the machine can be given as gifts to strengthen your bonds with your teammates.
german: Eine Maschine, die in der Lage ist, eine Vielzahl von Artikeln herzustellen. Wählen Sie einfach den gewünschten Artikel aus und legen Sie die benötigten Materialien ein - so einfach das gewünschte Material ein! So einfach ist das! Die von der Maschine kann verschenkt werden, um Ihre Bindung zu stärken Sie Ihre Verbindungen mit Ihren Teamkollegen zu stärken.

english: Contains specialized equipment to adjust and customize Class Weapons.
german: Enthält spezielle Ausrüstung zur Anpassung und Anpassung von Klassenwaffen.

english: A hospital in the Tokyo Residential Complex that Shouma remembers. He says he was placed in a capsule-like machine there. There's a room in the academy with machines just like them...
german: Ein Krankenhaus im Tokyo Residential Complex, an das sich Shouma erinnert. Er sagt, er wurde dort in eine Kapsel-ähnliche Maschine gelegt. Es gibt einen Raum in der Akademie mit Maschinen wie sie...

english: A school largely identical to Last Defense Academy, except for its lack of Undying Flames. There's also nothing inside its Defense Room - the whole school is just a decoy.
german: Eine Schule, die weitgehend identisch mit der letzten Verteidigungsakademie ist, mit Ausnahme des Fehlens von Unsterblichen Flammen. Es gibt auch nichts in ihrem Verteidigungsraum - die ganze Schule ist nur ein Köder.

english: This vehicle was placed at Second-to-Last Defense Academy so their team could one day join the others at the main campus. A fire extinguisher is mounted to the front of the bus, allowing it to drive through Undying Flames.
german: Dieses Fahrzeug wurde in der Second-to-Last Defense Academy platziert, so dass ihr Team eines Tages den anderen am Hauptcampus beitreten konnte. Ein Feuerlöscher ist an der Vorderseite des Busses montiert, so dass es durch Undying Flames fahren kann.

english: A special form of Class Armor used by those with weak hemoanima. It still requires some hemoanima to activate, so it can't be used by just anyone.
german: Eine spezielle Form der Klasse Rüstung von denen mit schwachen Hämoanima verwendet. Es erfordert immer noch einige Hämoanima zu aktivieren, so dass es nicht von jedem verwendet werden kann.

english: A classroom filled with explosives and firearms. The equipment here can be used to manufacture traps to use in battle.
german: Ein Klassenzimmer gefüllt mit Sprengstoff und Schusswaffen. Die Ausrüstung hier kann verwendet werden, um Fallen zu produzieren, die im Kampf verwendet werden.

english: A classroom equipped with an operating table, anatomical models, and an array of toxic-looking chemicals. The equipment here can be used to manufacture stat-enhancing items to use in battle.
german: Ein Klassenzimmer ausgestattet mit einem Operationstisch, anatomischen Modellen und einer Reihe von toxisch aussehenden Chemikalien. Die Geräte können hier verwendet werden, um stat-enhancing Elemente zu produzieren, um im Kampf zu verwenden.

english: Kamukura General Hospital was conducting research on people with a special kind of blood. Shouma wasn't the only person sealed in a strange capsule at the hospital—the whole Special Defense Unit was there, too.
german: Das Kamukura General Hospital forschte an Menschen mit einer besonderen Art Blut. Shouma war nicht die einzige Person, die im Krankenhaus in einer seltsamen Kapsel versiegelt war – auch die gesamte Spezialverteidigungseinheit war da.

english: Long ago, humanity's abuse of the environment reached such an extreme level that Earth began to wish for its own destruction. The will of the planet caused natural disasters and abnormal weather conditions in an attempt to wipe out all life. This phenomenon became known as World Death. The surviving vestiges of humanity have now retreated to underground shelters to stave off extinction for as long as they can.
german: Long ago, humanity's abuse of the environment reached such an extreme level that Earth began to wish for its own destruction. The surviving vestiges of humanity have now retreated to underground shelters to stave off extinction for as long as they can.

english: Cages located in the academy's courtyard, better suited to keeping prisoners than domestic animals. The metal bars aren't the cages' only defense - they also generate electromagnetic waves. These waves stop prisoners from using any special powers they might possess.
german: Im Hof der Akademie befindliche Käfige, die sich besser zur Gefangenenhaltung eignen als Haustiere. Die Metallstangen sind nicht die einzige Verteidigung der Käfige, sondern erzeugen auch elektromagnetische Wellen. Diese Wellen verhindern, dass Gefangene, dass Gefangene irgendwelche Spezialkräfte, die sie über die sie verfügen, die sie besitzen.

In truth, the members of the Special Defense Unit have all been blessed with this mysterious substance. Their Infusers actually serve the role of stimulating their cryptoglobin to make it battle ready at a moment's notice.
german: {fc(ff635b)Abnormes Blut} with unique combat properties. Cryptoglobin can morph between solid and liquid states, creating a physical manifestation of the user's will. In truth, the members of the Special Defense Unit have all been blessed with this mysterious substance. Their Infusers actually serve the role of stimulating their cryptoglobin to make it battle ready at a moment's notice.

The unnatural blood and her body's immune system are fundamentally at odds with each other, causing rejection symptoms to flare up from time to time. The unnatural blood and her body's immune system are fundamentally at odds with each other, causing rejection symptoms to flare up from time to time. Nozomi's mother became so obsessed with her project that she didn't hesitate to use her own daughter as a test subject. Due to her failure to completely mitigate the rejection symptoms, the project was shut down, replaced by the formation of a new team of cryptoglobin-wielding youths. Nozomi later snuck back into the hospital and infiltrated the Special Defense Unit, being sent to Second-to-Last Defense Academy with Moko and the others.

english: The strongest of the commanders and the leader of the invaders. After surviving Nigou's self-destruct attack at the other academy, she has set her sights on the one and only Last Defense Academy.
german: Die Stärkste der Kommandeure und Anführerin der Invasoren. Nachdem sie Nigous Selbstzerstörungsangriff auf die andere Akademie überlebt hatte, hat sie ihre Blicke auf die eine und einzige Letzte Verteidigungsakademie gerichtet.

english: A plan devised for humanity to escape World Death by temporarily leaving Earth. Phase One of this project involved the construction of a massive spaceship - the Artificial Satellite that can still be seen in the sky. This is where the surviving population of the Tokyo Residential Complex now reside.
german: In Phase eins dieses Projekts ging es um den Bau eines riesigen Raumschiffs - des künstlichen Satelliten, der noch immer am Himmel zu sehen ist. Hier wohnt heute die überlebende Bevölkerung des Wohnkomplexen in Tokio.

english: In a capsule-like machine in the Defense Room is a tiny newborn baby. In spite of his size, his cryptoglobin is so powerful that he is constantly generating Undying Flames. The boy made of Undying Flames Takumi saw around the school was an avatar created by the baby. When the time is right, his flames will be used to raze the planet, destroying the invaders and giving humanity a fresh start.
german: In a capsule-like machine in the Defense Room is a tiny newborn baby. In spite of his size, his cryptoglobin is so powerful that he is constantly generating Undying Flames. The boy made of Undying Flames Takumi saw around the school was an avatar created by the baby. When the time is right, his flames will be used to raze the planet, destroying the invaders and giving humanity a fresh start.

english: 100 days after activation, Last Defense Academy will shift into Attack Mode, launching missiles in every direction. These missiles have been filled with Undying Flames provided by the baby in the Defense Room.
german: 100 Tage nach der Aktivierung schaltet Last Defense Academy in den Angriffsmodus und feuert Raketen in alle Richtungen ab. Diese Raketen wurden mit Flammen gefüllt, die vom Baby im Verteidigungsraum bereitgestellt wurden.

english: When the school enters Attack Mode, the Special Defense Unit will need to evacuate so they don't get caught in the final assault. This lightweight spacecraft will take them back to the Artificial Satellite to rejoin humanity.
german: Wenn die Schule den Angriffsmodus betritt, muss die Spezialverteidigungseinheit evakuieren, damit sie nicht beim letzten Angriff erwischt werden. Diese leichte Raumsonde bringt sie zurück zum Künstlichen Satelliten, um wieder der Menschheit beizutreten.

english: After absorbing the baby's cryptoglobin, Takumi's Specialist Skill became powerful enough to send him back in time to {fc(ff635b)redo} his hundred days at the academy from the beginning.
german: Nach dem Absorbieren des Baby-Kryptoglobin, Takumi's Specialist Skill wurde mächtig genug, um ihn zurück in der Zeit zu {fc(ff635b)Wiedereinsetzen} seine hundert Tage an der Akademie von Anfang an.

english: An explosive filled with Undying Flames. It's capable of destroying even commander-class enemies without a trace. The one catch is that it needs hemoanima to detonate it.
german: Ein explosiver Sprengstoff gefüllt mit Unsterblichen Flammen. Er ist in der Lage, sogar befehlsklasse Feinde ohne Spur zu zerstören. Der eine Haken ist, dass er Hämoanima braucht, um es zu detonieren.

english: The process Sirei used on Eva to make her switch sides. Originally a medical treatment, it can alter a patient's neural pathways to influence their thoughts and emotions. Specific memories can be erased, or new ones implanted. Let's not beat around the bush about this - it's brainwashing, plain and simple.
german: The process Sirei used on Eva to make her switch sides. Originally a medical treatment, it can alter a patient's neural pathways to influence their thoughts and emotions. Specific memories can be erased, or new ones implanted. Let's not beat around the bush about this - it's brainwashing, plain and simple.

english: The program Sirei uses to make decisions. It simulates the {fc(ff635b)thought patterns of all mankind}, ensuring he always does what's best for the species as a whole.
german: Das Programm Sirei trifft Entscheidungen. Es simuliert das {fc(ff635b)Denkmuster der ganzen Menschheit} und sorgt dafür, dass er immer das Beste für die Spezies als Ganzes tut.

english: The true nature of humanity's plan was to abandon Earth and find a new world to call home. They set their sights on a planet designated KXK-787, and traveled there on the Artificial Satellite. The whole of the Tokyo Residential Complex still exists on board this giant spaceship.
german: Der wahre Plan der Menschheit bestand darin, die Erde zu verlassen und eine neue Welt zu finden, in der sie ihr Zuhause nennen. Sie nahmen einen Planeten namens KXK-787 ins Visier und reisten mit dem künstlichen Satelliten dorthin. An Bord des Satelliten. An Bord des riesigen Raumschiffes existiert noch immer noch der gesamte Wohnkomplex in Tokio. An Bord dieses gigantischen Raumschiffs befindet sich noch immer.

english: A planet called KXK-787 by Earth's scientists, known by its own people as Futurum. Its environment is remarkably similar to Earth's, and it even has intelligent human-like inhabitants. In Futuran society, those born with cryptoglobin (like the enemy commanders) are considered {fc(ff635b)heroes chosen by God}. When humanity's forces invaded Futurum, cryptoglobin users were the one obstacle they could not overcome. Now, after generations of bloody warfare, it seems that is about to change...
german: A planet called KXK-787 by Earth's scientists, known by its own people as Futurum. Its environment is remarkably similar to Earth's, and it even has intelligent human-like inhabitants. In Futuran society, those born with cryptoglobin (like the enemy commanders) are considered {fc(ff635b)von Gott auserwählte Helden}. When humanity's forces invaded Futurum, cryptoglobin users were the one obstacle they could not overcome. Now, after generations of bloody warfare, it seems that is about to change...

english: Last Defense Academy is not a tool of defense, but invasion. It was launched from the Artificial Satellite to destroy the planet's native inhabitants and provide humanity with a new home. It needs 100 days to properly charge up for its final assault.
german: Letzte Verteidigungsakademie ist kein Instrument der Verteidigung, sondern Invasion. Sie wurde vom Künstlichen Satelliten gestartet, um die einheimischen Bewohner des Planeten zu zerstören und die Menschheit mit einem neuen Zuhause zu versorgen.

english: Due to a random mutation, this young man was born with incredibly strong cryptoglobin. His power was like nothing the planet had ever seen before, so much so that he was considered on par with divinity, and became known as the Second Coming. Earth's forces kidnapped him when he was still a baby, hoping to use this power for their own ends.
german: Due to a random mutation, this young man was born with incredibly strong cryptoglobin. His power was like nothing the planet had ever seen before, so much so that he was considered on par with divinity, and became known as the Second Coming. Earth's forces kidnapped him when he was still a baby, hoping to use this power for their own ends.

english: The entire Special Defense Unit are clones created from Shion's genetic material. Their lives in the Tokyo Residential Complex were nothing but false memories implanted to give them a reason to fight for humanity. In short, Takumi and the others are just living weapons, manufactured to advance mankind's invasion of Futurum.
german: The entire Special Defense Unit are clones created from Shion's genetic material. Their lives in the Tokyo Residential Complex were nothing but false memories implanted to give them a reason to fight for humanity. In short, Takumi and the others are just living weapons, manufactured to advance mankind's invasion of Futurum.

english: A weapon created to break through a certain commander's defenses. When activated, it releases a poison gas that degrades cryptoglobin.
german: Eine Waffe, die geschaffen wurde, um die Verteidigung eines bestimmten Kommandanten zu durchbrechen. Wenn sie aktiviert wird, gibt sie ein Giftgas frei, das Kryptolobin degradiert.

english: The creatures Sirei called School Invaders are living weapons created by V'ehxness. She made them by mutating human prisoners, as well as her own people, into grotesque monsters.
german: Die Kreaturen Sirei genannt School Invaders sind lebende Waffen von V'ehxness. Sie machte sie durch die Mutation von menschlichen Gefangenen, wie auch ihr eigenes Volk, zu grotesken Monstern.

english: A system designed to protect the Defense Room if it is breached during the countdown to the final assault. It forces Shion to create more Undying Flame avatars and eliminate any threats to the school.
german: Ein System, das entwickelt wurde, um den Verteidigungsraum zu schützen, wenn er während des Countdowns zum letzten Angriffs durchbrochen wird. Es zwingt Shion, mehr Avatare Undying Flame zu schaffen und alle Bedrohungen für die Schule zu eliminieren.

english: Not all Futurans are content to live under V'ehxness's military dictatorship, as evidenced by this resistance group. Though they lack the strength to oppose the Supreme Commander directly, behind the scenes they are hard at work trying to sabotage her regime.
german: Nicht alle Futuraner begnügen sich damit, unter der Militärdiktatur V 'ehxness zu leben, wie diese Widerstandsgruppe beweist. Obwohl es ihnen an der Kraft mangelt, dem Oberbeweist, dem Oberbefehligt zu widerstehen, hinter den Kulissen sie hart daran zu arbeiten, ihr Regime zu sabotieren, ihr Regime zu sabotieren.

english: A young girl blessed with analysis-focused cryptoglobin. Her venerated status and flair for strategy has made her one of the rebellion's greatest leaders. She is Eva's adopted daughter and has lived with her since her biological parents were executed for defying V'ehxness.
german: Sie ist Evas Adoptivtochter und lebt bei ihr, seit ihre leiblichen Eltern hingerichtet wurden, weil sie sich der V 'ehxness widersetzt haben.

english: A group of humans opposed to the Exodus Project. Rather than steal the Futurans' planet, this group would rather live out their remaining days on the Artificial Satellite. They have accepted humanity's inevitable extinction and have no wish to struggle against their fate.
german: Eine Gruppe von Menschen, die gegen das Exodus-Projekt ist. Statt den Planeten der Futuraner zu stehlen, würde diese Gruppe lieber ihre verbleibenden Tage auf dem künstlichen Satelliten verbringen. Sie haben die unvermeidliche Auslöschung der Menschheit akzeptiert und haben und haben keinen Wunsch, gegen ihr Schicksal kämpfen wollen.

english: Mysterious artifacts spoken of in ancient legends. Whoever gathers the seven Boxes of Blessings will have any wish granted. However, opening a Box of Calamity instead will bring disaster on the world...
german: Mysteriöse Artefakte, von denen in antiken Legenden gesprochen wird. Wer die sieben Boxen des Segens sammelt, wird jeden Wunsch haben. Jedoch wird das Öffnen einer Box von Calamity die Welt verunglücken lassen...

english: "Beneath the royal tomb sleep thirteen boxes - seven Boxes of Blessings and six Boxes of Calamity. In days past, people knew how to tell the boxes apart, but this knowledge has long since been lost. Our sole surviving clue is the phrase 'blessings stand alone.' One who brings all seven Boxes of Blessings together and opens them will attain great power. One who opens even a single Box of Calamity will invite tragedy the likes of which has never been seen in our time."
german: "Beneath the royal tomb sleep thirteen boxes - seven Boxes of Blessings and six Boxes of Calamity. In days past, people knew how to tell the boxes apart, but this knowledge has long since been lost. Our sole surviving clue is the phrase 'blessings stand alone.' One who brings all seven Boxes of Blessings together and opens them will attain great power. One who opens even a single Box of Calamity will invite tragedy the likes of which has never been seen in our time."

english: A parasitic life form that permanently bonds with and controls its host. They follow a eusocial structure in which the more numerous males serve the females, or queens. G'ie Queens possess carnivorous lifeforms and lay eggs in corpses, which the males hatch into and bond with.
german: A parasitic life form that permanently bonds with and controls its host. They follow a eusocial structure in which the more numerous males serve the females, or queens. G'ie Queens possess carnivorous lifeforms and lay eggs in corpses, which the males hatch into and bond with.

english: A G'ie female that lays a single egg containing the next generation's queen. A G'ie Queen will fuse with its host's brain, gaining control of its body and sharing its intelligence. The queen's role is to secure corpses to lay her eggs in - the more dead bodies there are, the better. As such, a person or animal possessed by one of these parasites will be driven to kill over and over again. english: A substance with cryptoglobin-absorbing properties. A surface coated in {fc(ff635b)Material Ω} can even survive contact with Undying Flames unharmed.

english: A carrying case for the baby in the Defense Room. It is fitted with life support systems, and the inside is coated with {fc(ff635b)Material Ω} to protect it from the Undying Flames.

english: Several ancient legends speak of this mysterious creature. Not much is known about it, except that it is able to create something called a {fc(ff635b)Ruby Tear}, which can restore the dead to life.
german: Mehrere alte Legenden sprechen von dieser geheimnisvollen Kreatur. Über sie ist nicht viel bekannt, außer dass sie in der Lage ist, etwas namens {fc(ff635b)Ruby Tear} zu schaffen, das die Toten zum Leben zurückbringen kann.

english: A substance created by Retsnom that can raise the dead. This will even work on cryptoglobin users that have lost all their blood and can't be revived by other means. How or why Retsnom creates the {fc(ff635b)Ruby Tear}, the legends don't tell us...
german: Eine Substanz, die von Retsnom entwickelt wurde und die Tote auferwecken kann. Dies funktioniert sogar bei Kryptoglobinkonsumenten, die ihr ganzes Blut verloren haben und nicht wiederbelebt werden können. Wie oder nicht wiederbelebt werden können. Wie oder warum Retsnom die nicht wiederbelebt werden können. {fc(ff635b)Ruby Tear}, erzählen uns die Legenden nicht...

english: A phenomenon affecting Last Defense Academy that forces Takumi and Hiruko to repeat their time here over and over again. The loop begins on the night of Day 2 and resets at 10:00 am on Day 100, or when the looper in question dies.
german: Ein Phänomen, das die Last Defense Academy betrifft und Takumi und Hiruko zwingt, ihre Zeit hier immer und immer wieder zu wiederholen. Die Schleife beginnt in der Nacht von Tag 100 um 10: 00 Uhr oder wenn der zweite Tag 100, oder wenn der Looper stirbt. Die Schleife beginnt.

english: Alternate realities created by making different choices, leading to different outcomes. Depending on the timeline, Last Defense Academy can be a very different place, even in ways that don't make sense at first glance. Normally, everyone's memories of past timelines are erased when the loop resets. However, under certain circumstances, those with the right kind of cryptoglobin may be able to remember them...

english: The act of moving from one timeline (parallel universe) to another. This is not the same as time travel - it's strictly moving to the same point in time in a different world. It's also a different phenomenon to the time loop, in that it involves physically traveling to another timeline, not just sending one's consciousness. So far as anyone knows, parallel leaps can only be achieved using a machine located in a lab on the outskirts of a certain ruined city...

english: A suit used to protect the wearer from the adverse effects of parallel leaping. It is made with technology that repels hemoanima (cryptoglobin). As such, the suit prevents the wearer from using their Class Armor, but also nullifies any attacks made by Class Weapons. Leaping without a suit can cause leap damage. Symptoms of this condition include impaired consciousness and cryptoglobin loss.

english: Every timeline exists within a space filled with cryptoglobin energy, dubbed "Bloodspace" by Hiruko. As such, leaps can only be performed when the waves are at a high enough level.

english: In the event of all but one of the Special Defense Unit's initial ten members being wiped out, the sole survivor can be evacuated back to the Artificial Satellite. To initiate this process, they must input a series of numbers into the Distress Signal Transmitter. Both the transmitter and the correct numbers are hidden somewhere in Last Defense Academy.

Um diesen Prozess einzuleiten, müssen sie eine Reihe von Zahlen in den Sekundenweise in den Sekundenweise eingeben. Sowohl der Sender. Sowohl der Sender als auch die richtigen Zahlen. english: If a member of the Special Defense Unit's initial team loses all their cryptoglobin, they die permanently and can no longer be revived. When they enter this state of "Total Death," a number will appear on their back. This is known as a Livor Mortis Code. Correctly inputting nine codes into the Distress Signal Transmitter will allow any surviving members of the Special Defense Unit to escape from the enemy and go back to the Artificial Satellite.

The Distress Signal Transmitter is actually a detonation device - inputting the Livor Mortis Codes will cause the school to self-destruct, causing widespread destruction for miles around.

english: A chemical substance that corrodes metal. It occurs at a quantum level, but quickly multiplies using the energy released during oxidation, making it a very real threat. Please note, it is not a living organism - the "bacteria" part of the name is just to help convey its size and reproduction process.
german: Es handelt sich um eine chemische Substanz, die Metall angreift. Sie kommt auf Quantenhafter Ebene vor, vermehrt sich aber durch die während der Oxidation freigesetzte Energie schnell und ist daher eine sehr reale Bedrohung. Bitte beachten Sie ist kein lebendiger Organismus - der Bezeichnung. Der "Bakterien" Teil des Namens soll nur dazu beitragen, ihre Größe und ihre Größe und Reproduktionsprozess zu vermitteln.

english: The only known substance capable of purging Particle Bacteria. It can't be found or synthesized in the Bio Lab, but there might be some in the ruins outside the school...
german: Die einzige bekannte Substanz, die Partikelbakterien reinigen kann. Sie kann nicht im Biolabor gefunden oder synthetisiert werden, aber es könnte einige in den Ruinen außerhalb der Schule sein...

english: A machine that detects organic life within a set range. Its range currently extends as far as the Wall of Fire. It's not able to give detailed readings on where any detected lifeforms are located.
german: Eine Maschine, die organisches Leben innerhalb eines festgelegten Bereichs erkennt. Ihr Bereich erstreckt sich derzeit bis zur Feuerwand. Sie kann keine detaillierten Messwerte geben, wo sich alle erkannten Lebensformen befinden.

english:
A game in which players are forced to kill as many invaders as they can to earn points. At the end of each round, the hunter with the lowest score is executed and has their cryptoglobin absorbed. Additional rules are as follows:
・Invaders killed within school grounds do not count toward the score.
・Players are prohibited from harming the sponsor, on pain of death.
・The game will end immediately if the sponsor harms a player without just cause.
